name: etabs-connector
description: Local MCP connector with guarded access to the full installed ETABS 23 API.

interface.shortDescription: Access the complete ETABS 23 API with guarded reads, writes, and analysis.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to local ETABS 23 through a .NET 8 MCP server with purpose-built workflows plus discovery and guarded invocation of all methods in the installed ETABS API assembly.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my active ETABS model and summarise it.
Save a working copy, then change selected sections.
Run analysis and extract selected reactions.
